transcript: Ten things people with high functioning anxiety do without even realizing it, if this sounds like you, just know. You are not alone. One, you rehearse conversations before they even happen. Two, you apologize constantly, even when nothing is your fault. Three, you panic when someone's tone slightly changes. Four, you overthink everything, every text, every look, every silence. Five, you feel guilty when you rest, as if slowing down means you're falling behind. Six, you over-explain yourself when you really don't have to. Seven, you constantly prepare for the worst case scenario. Your mind is always trying to protect you from pain that hasn't even happened. Eight, you struggle to relax, even at night, even when your body is tired, your mind keeps running. Nine, you feel responsible for how other people feel, even when it has nothing to do with you. Ten, you stay busy all the time, because sitting alone with your thoughts feels overwhelming. And the strange part is, most people would never know. You look calm on the outside, but internally you are exhausted. This is what high-functioning anxiety feels like. A nervous system that has been in survival mode for too long. I'm still learning how to heal this too, and maybe that's why we're here together. If you are trying to heal emotionally, mentally, and spiritually, I wrote an e-book called The Path Through Pain. It may help you feel a little less lost. Link in bio.
